t: Sally Gabori - Artist Biography
s: She fell in love with paint and colour, with which she depicts her country and her ancestral stories: representing her land and seascapes in an outburst of colour. Sally Gabori has become one of the most highly regarded and sought after contemporary Australian artists, who has been exhibited Australia-wide and internationally.
